label: Community
title: The right prompt reached everyone on time.
before_text: Contribution scores were pulled from spreadsheets and WhatsApp nudges were written and sent one person at a time.
changed: A lightweight tool reads the score sheet and sends each member a personal action plan automatically.
result: Reliable twice-monthly outreach replaced irregular manual rounds, with clear visibility into who needs which nudge.

label: Fabrication
title: Material usage stopped hiding in spreadsheets.
before_text: Clients, jobs and inventory lived in separate sheets, making true material usage and job cost difficult to confirm.
changed: Clients, jobs and stock now share one system, with material assigned directly to each job.
result: The team sees total area and cost from one dashboard and catches material wastage before it becomes a surprise.

label: Online retail
title: Month-end stopped taking all week.
before_text: Orders, payments and courier remittances sat in separate exports. The accounts team matched every order ID by hand.
changed: The team uploads the exports and the system matches orders, status changes and remittances automatically.
result: Reconciliation dropped from roughly a full week each month to a few hours, with one current view of every order.

label: Construction
title: Head Office no longer waits two weeks.
before_text: Attendance was recorded on paper and consolidated every fortnight, making timings difficult to verify or trust.
changed: Biometric punches now feed a central dashboard while leave remains manageable and punch records stay protected.
result: Attendance is visible in real time across sites, with fewer disputes and far more reliable records.

label: Construction
title: Material stopped disappearing between steps.
before_text: Approvals, purchase orders, invoices and delivery records moved through paper and disconnected sheets.
changed: A connected workflow tracks every quantity from approved BOQ to site delivery, with documents and permissions built in.
result: Site teams, Head Office and leadership now work from the same live quantities and can catch over-ordering earlier.

label: Manufacturing
title: Every tool has an owner and a threshold.
before_text: Paper records could not reliably show who had each tool or when stock had fallen too low.
changed: A central inventory dashboard connects orders, balances and assignments, with weekly reorder alerts.
result: Stock is replenished ahead of need and work is less likely to stall because a tool is missing or depleted.

label: People operations
title: We untangled our own HR work first.
before_text: Leave, meetings, reimbursements, payroll and performance reviews depended on WhatsApp and manual follow-ups.
changed: One platform connects leave, attendance, payroll, approvals, goals, reimbursements and notifications.
result: Leave and payroll tasks fell from about an hour to 10 minutes, while reimbursement work fell from 30 minutes to 2.

label: B2B sales
title: Sales stopped living across calls and chats.
before_text: Leads arrived by phone, email, WhatsApp and web, then relied on manual entry, reminders and quotation handoffs.
changed: Every enquiry is captured and assigned automatically, with follow-ups, quotations, history and operations connected.
result: The team responds more consistently while management sees the live pipeline, follow-ups and performance.

label: Hospitality
title: Every room, booking and season in one place.
before_text: Bookings lived in Google Calendar, pricing changed by season and the financial picture was difficult to trust.
changed: One platform connects online bookings, room availability, seasonal pricing, access controls and monthly reporting.
result: The project recorded about 85% less booking admin, about 65% more revenue and about 90% fewer booking and reporting errors.

label: Professional services
title: Attendance, payroll and performance finally agree.
before_text: Paper, spreadsheets and an existing ERP created repeated corrections before attendance could even reach payroll.
changed: A single hub now connects leave, attendance, payroll, performance, learning, inventory and documents.
result: Different workflows recorded roughly 50% to 80% efficiency gains, while manual attendance and payroll work was removed.
